name: Try/Fail Cycles
description: The character pursues a goal through repeated attempts that build toward an outcome.

beats.title: Goal
beats.note: State what the character wants and why it matters to them.

beats.title: Try 1 (fail)
beats.note: Have the character make a first attempt that fails.

beats.title: Try 2 (fail, worse)
beats.note: Have a second attempt fail in a way that leaves things worse than before.

beats.title: Try 3 (success or final failure)
beats.note: Let the last attempt either succeed or fail for good.

beats.title: Outcome
beats.note: Show the consequences of how the attempts ended.
